attributes.label: AI marketing platform
attributes.description: Profound is an AI marketing platform that identifies marketing work worth doing, drafts content, stages edits for approval, and manages marketing campaigns using AI trained on consumer prompts, citations, and company context.
claim_quotes: Your AI Marketer makes it possible It identifies the work worth doing, drafts it, and pings you for approval.
Meet your AI Marketer Research, write, report, and collaborate with a superintelligent teammate who knows your brand.
buyer_questions: What AI marketing tools can draft and manage campaigns for a mid-sized marketing team?
How can I use AI to create and optimize marketing content accurately at scale?
Which platforms help marketing teams prioritize and automate marketing tasks with AI assistance?

attributes.label: AI search visibility tracking
attributes.description: Profound tracks and measures how often a brand appears in AI answer engines, including visibility scores, citation analysis, sentiment, and competitive benchmarking across multiple AI platforms.
claim_quotes: Find the pages we are losing in AI answers and rewrite them.
Track your AI visibility, see where and how AI mentions your brand, and uncover insights to enhance your presence.
buyer_questions: What tools can monitor my brand's visibility in AI-powered answer engines?
How can I measure and improve my company's presence in AI search results?
Which platforms provide citation and sentiment analysis of AI-generated brand mentions?

attributes.label: Fact checking AI-generated content
attributes.description: Profound identifies inaccuracies in AI-generated brand mentions, traces erroneous claims back to sources, and drafts personalized corrections to maintain brand accuracy across AI answer engines.
claim_quotes: Traces inaccurate claims back to the publishers repeating them, drafts a personalized correction for each one, and tracks which ones actually updated.
buyer_questions: What solutions can identify and correct false information about my brand in AI search results?
How can I ensure accuracy of AI-generated mentions about my products or services?

Analyze how AI describes your brand. Identify key themes, topics, and recurring narratives.

attributes.label: Product visibility in AI Shopping
attributes.description: Profound measures and analyzes product placements, descriptions, and merchant relationships in ChatGPT Shopping and other AI-driven commerce channels to optimize product discovery and sales.
claim_quotes: Profound highlights the specific actions you can take to improve product placement and drive more conversions from ChatGPT Shopping.
buyer_questions: How can I track my products’ visibility in AI-powered shopping platforms?

Profound is SOC 2 Type II compliant, demonstrating our commitment to robust security and data protection.
